pages.title: Tide Pearl
pages.text: Water remnant. Later stages turn water against your enemies. Dropped by the Elder Guardian.

pages.title: Dormant and Latent
pages.text: $(l)Dormant$(): Water breathing, underwater sight and speed, and less damage from aquatic mobs. Fire is far more dangerous to you.$(br2)$(l)Latent$(): You can't drown. Attacks are stronger underwater or in rain.

pages.title: Awakened, Ascended, Transcendent, Apex
pages.text: $(l)Awakened$(): Underwater, nearby enemies are slowed, weakened, and pulled down. Your hits can waterlog enemies even outside the aura.$(br2)$(l)Ascended$(): Rain and water sustain you. A ward on a timer reduces heavy hits.$(br2)$(l)Transcendent$(): No more fire weakness. A drowning aura surrounds you, and heavily armored enemies can be launched upward.$(br2)$(l)Apex$(): Conduit Power underwater. Can execute weakened enemies caught in its aura.
